description: This file implements backtrace functions for the Xtensa architecture, including stack frame traversal, PC processing, and backtrace printing, with platform-specific helpers.

methods.name: xtensa_cpu_process_stack_pc
methods.description: Processes the program counter to map to address space, handling window bits and instruction address adjustments.

methods.name: xtensa_stack_ptr_is_sane
methods.description: Checks if a stack pointer is within a valid range for the platform.

methods.name: xtensa_ptr_executable
methods.description: Checks if a pointer points to executable memory for the platform.

methods.name: xtensa_backtrace_get_next_frame
methods.description: Retrieves the next stack frame in the backtrace, updating PC and SP.

methods.name: xtensa_backtrace_print
methods.description: Prints the backtrace up to a specified depth, handling corrupted frames and continuation.
